eva: quick check-in from last night's batchshape QoS tuner run. TL;DR: A100/A10 throughput up, unexpected p99 blip on H100 when large batch tokens are hit. attaching short notes below.

perf-bot: automated run summary (run-id=2026-03-batchshape-07)
A100: p50 +6.1%, p99 +0.7% (kernel=attn-opt-v2)
H100: p50 +2.3%, p99 +9.4% (kv-merge fallback observed)
A10: p50 +8.2%, p99 -1.0%
T4/L4: negligible change; variance within noise.
(bench harness: 5k traces, avg_seq=512, heavy tail to 8k)

eva: config we used for the run:
```
batching:
  max_tokens_per_batch:
    A100: 384000
    H100: 384000
    A10: 256000
    T4: 128000
    L4: 128000
  small_batch_preempt_ms: 12
  kv_fragment_threshold: 0.6
```

sam: which selector decision caused the H100 fallback? :eyes:
mujahid: kernel-selector logs show `kv_merge_kernel` probe failing for some large-shape worklets. selector fell back to `generic-kv`, which on H100 causes L2 contention and extra copies. snippet from selector log:
```
[selector] probe kernel=kv_merge_kernel success=false reason=missing_symbol:group_mma
[selector] fallback_kernel=generic-kv latency_delta_ms=4.8
```

kate: correlating with runtime traces — we see KV cache fragmentation spike during the run for chat workload: prefix-cache-hit dropped from 0.82 -> 0.55 in the 30m window around the change. likely because larger batches interleave different contexts so KV pages get evicted.

anya: propose a short-term mitigation: soft-step the batch token target when KV fragment > 0.25:
```
if kv_fragment_ratio > 0.25:
  max_tokens_per_batch *= 0.9  # soft throttle next window
```

mujahid: agreed. longer-term fix: update kernel probe order so `kv_merge_kernel` is preferred when available and add a lightweight micro-kernel for the large-SLS path on H100. filing PR with perf tests.

sam: can we add a dashboard metric for `kv_fragment_ratio` and `kernel_fallback_rate`? want per-device view + per-model.
kate: I'll add both to the console; will also add a regression alert if p99 delta > 5% over baseline.

eva: action items:
- mujahid: follow up on kernel-selector PR + perf test (owner)
- kate: dashboard + alert (owner)
- sam: run A/B with `small_batch_preempt_ms=8` vs `12` on H100 cluster (owner)
- anya: implement soft-step patch in runtime for next rolling window (owner)

eva: decision: hold H100 rollout until we confirm kernel probe fix or soft-step reduces p99 below 5% over baseline. will keep A100/A10 changes in the staging pool. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: note: full artifact with traces and flamegraphs uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/batchshape/2026-03-07-307654.

sam: thanks, will start A/B tomorrow morning.
